toegepas.blok: Vlieg is meer as net opstyg
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Voordat daar 'n enjin was' reads as if engines did not exist yet; the sense is that the brothers had no engine yet.
toegepas.fout: 'voordat daar 'n enjin was' is vague and can be read as engines not existing yet, while the paragraph means the brothers' own machine had none
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same people, same time and same action; the proposal states plainly what the paragraph means, adds no fact and touches no protected wording.

toegepas.voor: Die enjin het nie daardie vlugte lank gemaak nie
toegepas.na: Die enjin het daardie vlugte nie lank gemaak nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: With a definite object, 'nie' naturally follows the object in Afrikaans, and it then negates 'lank' precisely.
toegepas.fout: With a definite object, 'nie' before 'daardie vlugte' reads like English word order and blurs that 'lank' is what is negated
toegepas.rede_keurder: Natural Afrikaans places 'nie' after the definite object, so the negation falls on 'lank'; the meaning and the next sentence's 'wel' contrast stay intact.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Dit gly stadig al laer / deur die lug om hom
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Together these give 'Dit gly stadig al laer deur die lug om hom': the subject is 'dit' but the pronoun is 'hom' in one sentence, and the block 'Wat 'n enjin verander het' uses 'hy' for the glider. A person may want one pronoun throughout ('om dit' or 'Hy gly'); I did not change it because both wordings are protected.
